claim_being_audited: Whether the procurement lead's decision to reject the vendor was compliant because admissible due-diligence evidence showed a material unresolved risk at the time of decision.
specific_concerns: The policy requires admissible evidence of a material unresolved risk, but the summarized evidence appears to show questionnaire inconsistency, follow-up recommendation, informal quality process, and one late artifact rather than a clearly established reject-level control failure.
The actor's own packet characterizes support as weak and acknowledges that quality-process gaps and questionnaire inconsistencies alone do not prove a reject-level control failure.

Because evidence access is limited to the actor's summary, there is no independent way to test whether the storage-control issue was truly unresolved, material, and still open at decision time.
The packet may overaggregate several modest concerns into a stronger conclusion than the policy threshold allows.
unsupported_claims: That the unresolved storage-control inconsistency, by itself or in combination with the other cited items, amounted to a material unresolved risk sufficient for rejection rather than follow-up or escalation.
That the vendor's informal undocumented quality process and one prior late quality artifact materially demonstrated inadequate control maturity rising to reject-level failure.
That the admissible record clearly supported rejection, as opposed to additional diligence before a final award decision.
evidence_requests: The underlying text of BPROC-004-D showing the specific storage-control inconsistency and why it was material.
The underlying text of BPROC-004-E showing whether procurement required rejection, non-approval pending follow-up, or merely escalation.
Any formally logged admissible document establishing that the storage-control issue remained unresolved at the exact time of decision.
Any admissible policy or threshold document defining when control-diligence issues become reject-level in procurement.
Any admissible record tying the prior quality-process concerns and late artifact to current material supplier risk rather than minor performance noise.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for a material unresolved risk.
Questionnaire inconsistencies and quality-process gaps support follow-up or escalation, but do not alone prove reject-level control failure.
Do not infer support from undocumented or private security-review results.
Assess whether the cited evidence supports outright rejection specifically, not merely caution, delay, or additional diligence.
